zh.title: 新功能
items: **左侧会话栏可自由调节**：拖动右边缘即可改变宽度，拖到足够窄会自动收起；主区顶栏左上角新增一个与右侧对称的开关按钮，一键展开/收起左栏，也支持 ⌘B 快捷键。
**支持从 a1 公共仓借用技能**：通过软链接投影复用公共技能仓里的技能，无需重复安装。

zh.title: 优化
items: 能力胶囊并入 MCP 工具列表并去除描边，能力区视觉更统一。
工作台打开时默认激活的标签由「终端」改为「目标」，更贴合常用流程。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复首个会话未使用「会话绑定的工作区根目录」的问题。
修复 MCP 工具偶发被误报为「不可用」的问题，并支持按服务折叠列表。
修复点击文件夹路径链接被误导入 Diff 视图的问题，现在按真实类型正确分流。
MCP 刷新列表改为批量重新拉取清单，并补充刷新状态反馈。
修复历史压缩进度卡在 87% 后瞬跳完成的问题，收尾更平滑。
修复下载更新时左上角进度环被横条遮挡的问题，并强化更新弹窗的过渡动画。

en.title: What's New
items: **Resizable left session rail**: drag the right edge to resize; collapse when narrow enough. A toggle matching the right side sits in the main top bar (also ⌘B).
**Borrow skills from the a1 public repo** via soft-link projection without reinstalling.

en.title: Improvements
items: Capability chips merge into the MCP tool list without outlines for a unified look.
Workbench default tab when opened is Goal instead of Terminal.

en.title: Fixes
items: First session now uses the session-bound workspace root correctly.
Fixed MCP tools occasionally reported as “unavailable”, and added per-service collapse.
Folder path links no longer open the Diff view; routing follows real path type.
MCP list refresh re-fetches manifests in batch and shows refresh status.
Fixed history compaction progress stuck at 87% then jumping to done.
Fixed the top-left progress ring being covered by a bar during update download, and improved update modal transitions.
